##: 同花顺远航版. The download/id/275 endpoint always redirects to the newest build, which would silently break the hash on every upstream release, so this manifest pins the versioned CDN file instead. No checkver: the only machine-readable version API (ai.10jqka.com.cn) lags behind the CDN (it still reports 15.0.1.33 while 15.0.1.38 is served), so autoupdate would downgrade the pin. To bump: read the Location of download/id/275, update version + url, rerun bin/checkhashes.ps1.
description: [同花顺远航版] 同花顺官方版本，提供全面的股票行情及交易服务，界面简洁，功能强大
